inputs.x: float32 (1, T, 386): 369 song-token features (data/v6-song-tokens, docs/analysis-spec.md) ++ 17 note_context
inputs.tokens: int64 (1, T, 11): current canvas state, VOCAB[c] (= masked) for open entries
inputs.diff: int64 (1,): difficulty index in [Easy, Normal, Hard, Expert, ExpertPlus]
inputs.notes_known: int64 (1,): 1 when x carries real notes

wall_decode.formula: tok-1 = (kind*6 + lane)*4 + dur; kind in [side,crouch,dodge], lane in [-1,0,1,2,3,4], dur bucket -> DUR_VALUES
wall_decode.crouch: x = 0 if lane<=0 else min(lane,2); y=2; w = 4 if lane<=0 else 2; h=3; dur>=0.25

light_decode.formula: tok-2 = (mode*2 + colour)*3 + bright; value = (5 if colour A else 1) + mode; f = [0.5,1.0,1.4][bright]; tok 1 -> value 0 f 1.0

conditions_used.walls_c: 4 if the chart has planned walls else 1

columns.cells_0_11: for cell c = x*3+y: soonest note in that cell at or after the token time t: clip(1 - (t_note - t)/1.5, 0, 1); 0 when none
columns.density_12_14: for w in (0.5, 1.0, 2.0) s: (#notes with t <= time < t+w) / (w*8)
columns.hands_15_16: for hand h in (0 left, 1 right): x/3 of the last note of that hand with time <= t; before the first: 0.0 for hand 0, 0.5 for hand 1

note_context.note: notes use song seconds (before LEAD); searchsorted left for the cell lookup, right for the hand lookup

sampling.method: random-order ancestral unmasking (MaskGIT-style loop, random commit order)
sampling.given: channel 0 (walls) fixed to canvas_targets(times, walls) tokens; never masked
sampling.schedule: per window: total = #open entries; after step s (1-based) target_open = int(total*cos(pi/2*s/steps)); n_commit = max(1, open_now - target_open)
sampling.step: run the model on the window; for every open entry sample a token from softmax(logits/temperature) (inverse-CDF with u~U[0,1): first index whose cumsum > u); give every open entry a random priority u~U[0,1); commit the n_commit highest priorities; repeat until nothing is open
sampling.rng: numpy default_rng(seed) = PCG64; per step, channels in order 1..10: rng.random((n_open_c, 1)) for the inverse-CDF draws then rng.random(n_open_c) for the priorities; sort by priority descending (stable); seed = crc32(repr((song_id, difficulty, "lights"))) % 10000
sampling.windows: start=0; end=min(T, start+768); after a window start = end-128 (the overlap is already committed, so it stays given)
sampling.wall_channel: when generating walls (not in the browser flow) committed wall tokens must pass fair_wall or become 0

decode.light_events: (t+lead, et=group, value, f) per light channel token > 0
